item.title: Second loose utility chamber cover causing loud clanging noise whenever vehicles pass, 7th July
item.description:
There is a second utility chamber cover approximately 100 metres from the first reported location, closer to the pedestrian crossing. This cover is on the same road but closer to the roundabout and also appears to be loose and produces a loud metallic clanging/banging noise every time vehicles drive over it. As with the other cover, the repeated impact noise is occurring throughout the day and night and is causing a significant noise nuisance for nearby residents. The constant banging is particularly noticeable during quieter evening and night-time hours and is disrupting sleep and affecting the enjoyment of nearby homes. The issue has been present for months and would benefit from inspection and repair or adjustment to eliminate the movement and noise. To be clear, this is a separate defect from the other chamber cover reported near the pedestrian crossing. Both covers appear to be loose and together they create repeated impact noise along this stretch of road.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): A435, Bishop's Cleeve, Tewkesbury
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Incomplete SHOCKING WORK!!, 7th July
item.description:

Return from work to find liquid tar in road, on grass and driveway and splashed up front of car. One pothole has been filled but loose gravel left. Another has been half filled. There is tar all over the road and it has gone down the drain. This is terrible terrible "work". Complete waste of time and money. These are absolutely shocking "repairs".
